text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, the two of us held a 
meeting. Exchanging opinions with one 
another... This is truly how working as a 
three-legged race ought to be—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Umm... menu............ The priority 
should be....................

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
――Ah! S-S-S-So sorry,
it just... it looked 
so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, m-my snacking habit just kicked 
in because I was lost in thought, um, my 
hands moved on their own...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aaah...!? I-I thought it was sliced 
bread—! I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry! I, um... I 
took a b-bite out of it...!
Let me pay you 
back...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With all the hard work put into training 
and meetings, she must be hungry. Eating 
properly to recover is also an essential 
part of growth.
choice_data_list: Eat this and let's take a little b...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry, um... 
............T-Thank you for the food.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, let's continue the meeting then...! 
Uh, there's just...
something that came to 
mind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the snack, Cheval Grand 
seemed energized. She actively shared her 
thoughts, making it a very productive 
meeting.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, thank you very much. ...I feel 
like my head's finally starting to clear 
up a bit."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My hunger was pleasantly satisfied, and I 
felt relaxed. Thanks to that, our 
subsequent meeting went very smoothly.
